en: Black‑and‑white postcard view taken from an elevated, forested vantage point looking down over a small town or resort area nestled among hills. Tall conifer and birch trees frame the foreground, while scattered buildings and a winding road with a few people walking are visible in the mid‑distance. Text in Swedish is printed at the bottom left, and a publisher's imprint and logo appear at the bottom right.
